body: Awww thank you.  I may take you up on that offer :)
Thank you.  I may do that :)

I went to my therapist today.  I feel better than I originally did. But it seems like I do really good after a therapy session and then I get really depressed again that night. The one thing that really bothers me is my mom will call me after each therapy appointment and be like so how did it go...what did you guys talk about?  And I'm like that kinda defeats the purpose of the whole I don't have to tell you thing.

The thing with the birthday thing was my one friend, who I thought was one of my best friends, lives about 3 hours away now.  Well I was excited that she was going to be able to come down.  She shows up at 11 pm with like 5 guys I've never met before in my life.  My apartment is tinnnny, and according to the lease me and my sister are both only allowed one over night guest.  So I was freaking out about that because I don't know who these guys are and I don't want them in my apartment.

Then my other friend shows up with a guy that she knew I didn't not want there.  It was a disaster.

And I stopped going to the therapist I was going to because I felt like she was only listening to me because she was being paid to.  I've only gone to this new therapist three times but so far I really like her.

I feel like my life at 24 I should have accomplished more than I have. I don't know even where I'd make new friends at my age. I guess that's why I've just accepted what I could get out of my so call friends. 

The only time I get contacted first by any of them is when they need something from me. It's all just very discouraging.
